question: On your trackpad, does the way you pinch on the timeline pick what it zooms?
context: Shipped in 658cf1eb. The walks prove the axis choice with made-up fingers, but a real trackpad pinch cannot be done from a script, so only a person can confirm the touches arrive and the feel is right.

options.label: Feels right
options.summary: Side to side zooms time only, up and down makes rows taller only, and on the slant both. Nothing to change.
pros: The task closes as it is
options.mitigation: Tuning can still be asked for later.

options.label: Direction makes no difference
options.summary: Every pinch still zooms time and rows together, whichever way the fingers spread.
pros: Tells the loop the trackpad touches are not reaching the timeline
cons: Another pass is needed to read the fingers a different way
options.mitigation: Option and Shift still pick one axis in the meantime.

options.label: Works but needs tuning
options.summary: It picks by direction, but too often lands on the slant (both), or picks too slowly or too eagerly. Say which in a comment.
pros: Keeps the behaviour, adjusts the feel
cons: Needs a word from you on what feels off
options.mitigation: The angle (35 degrees) and the travel before deciding (about 2 mm) are single numbers to change.
